title: bheka.agent.enrolled.v1
description: Emitted by bheka-gateway when an endpoint agent completes enrolment and receives its mTLS certificate and tenant public key. Downstream services (bheka-ingest, bheka-policy) use this to open the expected ingestion channel for the agent_id. Per 011_ENDPOINT_AGENT_DESIGN section 11.

event_id.description: UUIDv7. De-duplicate consumers on this field.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC at which enrolment completed.

agent_id.description: UUIDv7 of the newly created agents row.

endpoint_id.description: UUIDv7 of the endpoints row. May be newly created or pre-existing (re-enrolment).

site_id.description: UUIDv7 of the site this endpoint belongs to.

platform.description: OS platform of the enrolling endpoint.

agent_version_id.description: UUIDv7 of the agent_versions row the agent enrolled at.

certificate_fingerprint.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 fingerprint of the mTLS cert issued at enrolment. Used by bheka-ingest to validate subsequent agent uploads.
